name: human_ai_thematic_v0
objective: maximise 126-session return vs SPY; graded beside ew / sector_etf / ai_only / spy twins
model: fable-5.1 draft (AI side) + Murat (human side, owed)
strategy: Murat's themes (tech/energy/pharma; lithium and chips; policy alignment; quantum; robotics/actuators; AI energy; FDA dates; gambling; news-driven) expressed only through names that carry a DATED observable and a falsifier. The largest weights sit where three independent methods agree the AI bottleneck moved to power (VRT/GEV/NVT), on memory allocation (MU), and on the one listed name on the winning side of betting's migration to prediction markets (HOOD). Binary FDA events are capped at 4%/10% combined. Deliberately not bought: MCD (five target cuts after the 09-23 investor day), DKNG/FLUT (flat legal handle), QUBT (target dispersion is the tell), OKLO/SMR, SERV (falsifier already fired), anything chosen because a screener said +50-300% (measured perverse, NEGATIVE_RESULTS 17).
